$comment: Traceability: blobs / message_attachments and conversation_workspaces table contracts (data-model.md). This is verb 3 of 4: fetch inputs. The worker restores workspace files and task inputs into the container (PoC: [...conversation.workspace, ...task.inputs]); over the seam it pulls bytes by content digest from the service instead of receiving them in-process. Bytes travel over the socket in bounded chunks, not via shared-filesystem reads: the worker reads only what the service hands it. The input manifest arrives in service.turn.start.

digest.description: Content digest of the input, from the turn.start inputs_manifest.

length.description: Requested chunk length, 1 byte to 256 KiB. Larger requests are rejected with payload_too_large.

offset.description: Byte offset into the input. Sequential chunking; the worker reassembles and verifies the digest.

title: worker.inputs.fetch
